Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE III OF 2000
ACCEDING STATE
(PROPERTY) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE III OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Acceding State (Property) Order, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st January, 2000
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub, dated
21-1-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Acceding State
(Property) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of Articles 3,5,6 and 7, P.O. No. 12 of 1961

ORDINANCE III OF 2000
ACCEDING STATE
(PROPERTY) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE III OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Acceding State (Property) Order, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st January, 2000
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub, dated
21-1-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:---
2. Amendment of Articles 3, 5,
6 and 7, P.O. No.12 of 1961.---In the Acceding State (Property) Order, 1961
(P.O. No.12 of 1961), in Articles 3, 5, 6 and 7, for the words "Provincial
Government", wherever occurring the words "Federal Government"
shall be substituted.
